desc: The 9RS (Reverse Stretch) innovative hybrid combines the larger 9CT receiver with the shorter 9KT barrel, resulting in a compact yet powerful firearm. By utilizing the Nitride heat-treated barrel with a 3-lug and threaded 1/2" x 28 muzzle, the 9RS reduces the overall length of the firearm while ensuring superior durability and accuracy. The larger 9CT receiver enhances control by cycling at a slower rate, allowing shooters to maintain better accuracy and stability. Includes two magazines, rear sights adjustment tool, cable lock, single-point bungee sling and case.
